author: Digital Foundry
description:
Thanks to Elgato for sponsoring this video. The Elgato 4K X and Elgato 4K Pro are essential tools in Digital Foundry's gameplay capture arsenal. Find out more here: https://e.lga.to/digitalfoundry

During the review process for GTA 6, John played on PS5 and PS5 Pro, while Oliver played on Xbox Series X and Series S. In this video, the duo come together to share their first impressions on the game and its 30fps frame-rate before moving onto the sheer scale of the technical achievement. A full multi-console head-to-head based on final retail code is in development, but for now, the panel share their thoughts on console performance and deciding which hardware offers objectively the best experience. And finally, gameplay - and there's much to discuss.
